decision.explanation: Document d1 explicitly states he served as a councillor in the Lyon City Council (2001-2008) and was elected to the South Australian House of Assembly in 2014; Document d2 contains contradictory claims about him being a French Vice President and holding a senior role in the French Ministry of the Interior, which conflict with the specific biographical details (dates, locations, and career path) provided in d1, suggesting d2 is unreliable or refers to a different context, thus only the positions confirmed by the detailed narrative in d1 are retained.
